fact: The brighter of the Heavenly Twins — an orange giant with a planet of its own.
bio: Pollux (Beta Geminorum) is an orange-hued giant star just 34 light-years away, the nearest giant to the Sun. It hosts a confirmed gas-giant planet, Pollux b, discovered from the star's slight wobble.
cultural: Pollux and neighbouring Castor are the 'Dioscuri', the twin brothers of Greek and Roman myth — Pollux the immortal son of Zeus. The pair have guided and guarded sailors since antiquity.
